caption_L1: This is a bar graph titled Forecast volume of pig meat exported from the European Union (EU 27) from 2015 to 2028 (in 1,000 tonnes). Year is plotted using a categorical scale starting at 2015 and ending at 2028* along the y-axis. A linear scale from 0 to 3,500 can be seen on the x-axis, labeled Volume in thousand tonnes.
caption_L2L3: from 2021 onward the amount of pig meat to be exported steadily increases. in 2016 and 2019 exportation peaked the highest. in 2015 the least pig meat was exported.
